label: BetterContact
description: Enrich contacts and company profiles, find leads and track search results

operations.name: get_account
operations.description: Read the account email and remaining credits.

operations.name: create_enrichment
operations.description: Start email, phone or LinkedIn profile enrichment for 1–100 leads. Consumes credits.

operations.name: get_enrichment
operations.description: Read one enrichment job. Only status terminated means processing is finished.

operations.name: create_lead_finder_search
operations.description: Start a lead search; paginate by keeping limit fixed and increasing offset. May consume credits.

operations.name: get_lead_finder_search
operations.description: Read a lead search job; on_hold needs more credits, processing needs another read later.

operations.name: create_company_finder_search
operations.description: Start a company search; paginate with limit and offset. Consumes search credits; no webhooks.

operations.name: get_company_finder_search
operations.description: Read a company search job; terminated can have an empty companies array.

operations.name: enrich_company
operations.description: Look up a company profile synchronously by domain or LinkedIn URL; consumes no credits.

operations.name: enrich_lead_by_linkedin
operations.description: Look up a lead profile by LinkedIn URL; costs 0.1 credit when found. No email or phone is returned.

operations.name: enrich_lead_by_name
operations.description: Look up a lead profile by name and company domain; costs 0.1 credit when found.
